name: Bert Evans Apprentice Scholarships
summary: Scholarship for first-year NSW apprentices facing financial or personal hardship, paid over three years.
key: Grant recipients may receive up to $15,000 over three years.
who: First-year apprentices approved in NSW, including school-based apprentices (trainees are not eligible)
Australian citizen or permanent resident employed by a NSW-based employer
catches: The 2026 round opened 18 May 2026 and closed 30 September 2026; watch for the next round.

source.label: NSW Government: Bert Evans Apprentice Scholarships 2026
